contract: DESIGN.md and REPORT.md: MCGB factual community site; direct navigation; original directory composition; source-backed copy.

accessibility.evidence: First-party keyboard tasks, axe scans, contrast, enlargement, reflow and error states passed. External map defects recorded in third-party.json; real screen readers untested. This scope does not claim full-page WCAG conformance.

responsive.evidence: 17 pages at eight widths plus doubled text sizes, spacing overrides and short drawer windows; no document overflow.

loading.evidence: Agenda announces Loading upcoming events and disables refresh while fetching; observed in current-run browser AX state.

empty.evidence: Actual source has no upcoming events; useful calendar subscription route remains. No-match filter state tested.

error.evidence: Failed feed, failed clipboard and blocked external embeds tested with usable alternatives.

partial.evidence: Refresh failure retains previously loaded events; verified in Chromium and WebKit.

success.evidence: Directory filters, organizer links, copy, resource-to-guide paths, PDF and form handoffs passed.

permission.evidence: Google Calendar view is explicitly optional/sign-in dependent and closed. Public agenda remains primary. No account access attempted.

renderedEvidence.observation: Current-run desktop homepage with blue banner, direct navigation and top-aligned sections.
Current-run phone homepage with visible library menu icon and stacked source-backed content.
